verdict.rationale: Replit docs show built-in AI/LLM integration (Connect to OpenAI and 100+ integrations, MCP servers for Stripe/Notion/Sentry, etc.) that Agent provisions automatically without manual OAuth/API key copy-pasting, similar to its auth/database provisioning pattern. However, evidence doesn't explicitly confirm LLM provider keys (e.g., OpenAI API keys) are fully managed/hidden the same way auth secrets are, nor independent corroboration of this specific flow. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that LLM/agent provider API keys (not just OAuth for third-party services) are auto-managed without user key entry, and independent/hands-on verification of this specific capability.
